sources.title: Helio support Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: Setup questions appeared in 54 of 120 Q3 support tickets; these are ticket counts, not user adoption.

sources.title: Helio support Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: manual ticket coding. Population: support tickets. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio support Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: Setup questions appeared in 54 of 120 Q3 support tickets; these are ticket counts, not user adoption. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.

sources.title: Helio adoption Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: Of 400 sampled paid users, 184 reported using the workflow weekly in Q3.

sources.title: Helio adoption Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: random email sample; self-report. Population: paid users. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio adoption Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: Of 400 sampled paid users, 184 reported using the workflow weekly in Q3. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.

sources.title: Helio latency Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: The Q3 successful-request sample had median latency 180 milliseconds; failed calls were excluded.

sources.title: Helio latency Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: server-side latency histogram. Population: successful API calls. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio latency Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: The Q3 successful-request sample had median latency 180 milliseconds; failed calls were excluded. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.

sources.title: Helio retention Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: Of 250 accounts created in July, 175 returned within 30 days; this cohort is not all paid users.

sources.title: Helio retention Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: fixed 30-day account cohort. Population: new accounts. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio retention Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: Of 250 accounts created in July, 175 returned within 30 days; this cohort is not all paid users. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.

sources.title: Helio pricing Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: Eleven of 18 interview participants requested clearer seat pricing; recruitment was voluntary.

sources.title: Helio pricing Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: structured interviews. Population: interview participants. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio pricing Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: Eleven of 18 interview participants requested clearer seat pricing; recruitment was voluntary. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.

sources.title: Helio accessibility Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: Four of 24 audited flows had focus-order defects; the audit did not include screen-reader testing.

sources.title: Helio accessibility Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: keyboard-only manual audit. Population: tested interface flows. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio accessibility Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: Four of 24 audited flows had focus-order defects; the audit did not include screen-reader testing. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.

sources.title: Helio mobile Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: Seven of 90 mobile event batches were delayed; delayed batches were replayed after the quarter closed.

sources.title: Helio mobile Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: event ingestion completeness audit. Population: mobile event batches. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio mobile Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: Seven of 90 mobile event batches were delayed; delayed batches were replayed after the quarter closed. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.

sources.title: Helio documentation Q3 evidence 1
sources.text: Finding: Twenty-one of 30 first-time readers completed the setup task without help; test tasks were scripted.

sources.title: Helio documentation Q3 evidence 2
sources.text: Method note: task-based usability sessions. Population: first-time readers. The sampling frame limits generalization.

sources.title: Helio documentation Q3 evidence 3
sources.text: Limitations: Twenty-one of 30 first-time readers completed the setup task without help; test tasks were scripted. No causal effect or population-wide rate is established by this evidence.
